title: Stubborn: A Streamlined and Unified Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Motion Tracking and Fall Recovery for Humanoids
abstract: arXiv:2606.12814v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent reinforcement learning approaches have shown great promise in improving humanoid motion tracking performance and achieving fall recovery under disturbances. However, most existing works treat motion tracking and fall recovery as different tasks and require multi-stage training with specialized recovery rewards and/or separate recovery policies. Moreover, existing reinforcement learning-based methods often terminate training episodes immediately after severe tracking failures, limiting recovery-oriented exploration in unstable or fallen states. To address the above issues, we propose Stubborn, a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery. Specifically, Stubborn uses an asymmetric Actor-Critic architecture and consists of three major components. First, a yaw-aligned tracking representation is adopted to reduce sensitivity to global drift and heading

translated_title: Stubborn：一个用于人形机器人鲁棒运动跟踪与摔倒恢复的精简统一强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 近期的强化学习方法在提升人形机器人运动跟踪性能以及实现干扰下的摔倒恢复方面展现出巨大前景。然而，现有的大多数工作将运动跟踪和摔倒恢复视为不同的任务，需要多阶段训练，并使用专门的恢复奖励和/或独立的恢复策略。此外，现有的基于强化学习的方法通常在出现严重跟踪失败后立即终止训练回合，限制了在不稳定或摔倒状态下面向恢复的探索。为解决上述问题，我们提出了Stubborn，一个精简且统一的强化学习框架，用于实现鲁棒的人形机器人运动跟踪和摔倒恢复。具体而言，Stubborn采用非对称Actor-Critic架构，由三个主要组件构成。首先，采用偏航对齐的跟踪表示来降低对全局漂移和航向的敏感性……
tldr: 提出了Stubborn框架，将运动跟踪与摔倒恢复统一为单一任务进行端到端训练，摆脱了传统多阶段训练和独立恢复策略的束缚，实现了人形机器人在干扰下的鲁棒运动跟踪与摔倒恢复。
en_tdlr: Stubborn is a streamlined and unified reinforcement learning framework that integrates motion tracking and fall recovery into a single task, eliminating the need for multi-stage training and separate recovery policies, to achieve robust humanoid motion tracking and fall recovery under disturbances.
